title: symphyotrichum × priceae
intro: Symphyotrichum × priceae, commonly known as the hybrid Michaelmas daisy, is a rare and unique plant species that is a cross between Symphyotrichum novae-angliae and Symphyotrichum pilosum. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, pain, and fever, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum × priceae include its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents, including triterpenoids and phenolic compounds, have been shown to have antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
